enabled.Name: Enable Narrative Assistant
enabled.Hint: Suggests a description after supported PF2e rolls.

output.Name: Output
output.Hint: Where suggestions go. A suggestion about a secret roll is always whispered to the GM.

source.Name: Narrative source
source.Hint: Module tables, or world tables carrying the same key (import a table from the compendium to customise it).

frequency.Name: Narration frequency
frequency.Hint: Limit suggestions to avoid chat spam.

disabledActions.Name: Disabled actions
disabledActions.Hint: Comma-separated PF2e action slugs, e.g.: seek, hide, sneak, recall-knowledge.

language.Name: Narration language
language.Hint: Language of the descriptions, independent of the UI. Falls back to English when no corpus exists for that language.
